title: GET /management/v1/version — success response
$comment: RC2 §11. The management_provider object identifies the adapter answering this contract; the managed_synth object identifies the synth it represents. Redeploying the adapter changes provider fields but MUST NOT imply a Homes Prime upgrade. additionalProperties is false for PROVIDER conformance only; see README.

deployment_id.$comment: RC2 §11.2: stable management-provider deployment-slot ID; 1-160 printable ASCII.

runtime_id.$comment: RC2 §11.2: unique management-provider runtime ID; 1-160 printable ASCII.

release_id.$comment: RC3 §11.2: exact opaque provider release ID matching /health; 1-128 printable ASCII characters. RC3 states this bound explicitly rather than leaving it inherited.

observed_release_id.$comment: RC2 §11.2: opaque observed Homes Prime release ID; ABSENT (never null, per §8) when no authoritative release observation exists.

supported_management_contracts.$comment: RC2 §11.2: sorted, non-empty, includes 1.0. Sortedness is enforced by invariant I-01.
